body: - **G-IO-1:** New `python/larch/design/design_settle.py` helper `_load_round_env_keys` reads the session-env `KEY=value` wire file with `Path.read_text` plus a hand-rolled parse (`export ` strip, `#` skip, first-wins, quote strip) instead of routing through `larch.io` (`read_kvs` / `parse_kv` with `reject_symlink` and `allowed_keys`). The module already imports `larch_io` for marker writes via `atomic_write`, so this is a new wire-file parse fork on the settle path rather than a throwaway internal file.
